A04AlignmentAssessment.meaning: Reviewer judgment of title/H1/early-answer intent alignment, not external measured score

reviewer: Independent Suncheon artifact and pixel reviewer
rubricOrigin: Same transparent criterion weighting as prior regional release assessment, applied afresh to this source/run/output. No prior city score is reused.

criteria.criterion: Early, direct first answer
criteria.reason: Home82/detail180 codepoints state wreath offer and consultation, with core answer beginning in opening sentence. Exact text checked in actual DOM and pixels.

criteria.criterion: Role-appropriate complete buyer answers
criteria.reason: Home offers discovery/budget/ribbon and article path. Article answers four products/prices/photos, total budget, scheduling, ribbon, venue, order inputs, change/refund, altar exclusion and collection. No FAQ quota applied to home.

criteria.criterion: Answers grounded without overclaiming
criteria.reason: Byte-retained independent factual review covers material assertions; limitations remain where current orders/stock/operations are unknown.

criteria.criterion: Semantic complete answers and one rendering per FAQ
criteria.reason: Actual HTML uses oneH1 and coherent section headings; all3 detail FAQ questions/answers appear once and are expanded, with no hidden answer copy. Home contains no duplicate product grid.

criteria.criterion: Useful next action and respectful provider tone
criteria.reason: Exact four product links and telephone consultation, clear desired-info guidance and conditional empathy; unchanged independently reviewed body.

criteria.criterion: Actual visible answer/FAQ/CTA evidence
criteria.reason: Runtime visibility plus reviewed full-page pixels at320/390/1280 confirm opening answer, full3FAQ and rendered actions. Product/FAQ crop overlays explicitly disclosed and not relied on alone.

AEO.meaning: Disclosed internal evidence-based readiness rubric; not measured ranking, visibility, conversion or AI-citation performance

criteria.criterion: Unambiguous provider, facility and service entities
criteria.reason: 꽃이랑 order consultation1844-0644 is separated from facility office contacts. Facility facts do not imply seller affiliation or altar service inclusion.

criteria.criterion: Material assertions retain classified primary evidence
criteria.reason: Current source69 and copy7 match original independent factual review; source card retains original verification dates and official facility/product/policy links. This is retained primary-evidence review, not new live source checking.

criteria.criterion: Local usefulness and distinct customer questions
criteria.reason: Room-floor grouping, non-assumed religious ribbon context and altar/wreath distinction help actual orders; home/detail roles and noindex support avoid duplicate intent.

criteria.criterion: Conditions and unknowns stay explicit
criteria.reason: Basic price versus delivered total, photograph appearance versus fulfillment, arrival request versus confirmed timing and change/refund limitations are present. No fake stock, round-the-clock service, fixed delivery or collection claim.

criteria.criterion: Readable semantic answers and source sections
criteria.reason: Source and FAQ sections are visible and distinctly headed; no fabricated schema/reviews. Home leads to actual source section on article; no claim of citation or AI-search performance.

GEO.meaning: Disclosed internal evidence-based readiness rubric; not measured ranking, visibility, conversion or AI-citation performance

criteria.criterion: Distinct query/intent and evidence-bound page role
criteria.reason: Selected facility purchasing intent and single-URL synonyms remain in frozen metadata; home is the entry role and actual detailed card, not a duplicate article.

criteria.criterion: Title/H1/first answer intent alignment
criteria.reason: Directly read actual titles/H1/opening text. Home names Suncheon/wreath/consultation; detail names the facility, wreath offer and buyer consultation. Opening answer lengths82/180 codepoints; core offer appears in first sentence.

criteria.criterion: Unique metadata and coherent heading structure
criteria.reason: All4 actual titles/descriptions unique, exactly oneH1 each, H2/H3 product/FAQ hierarchy has no level skip; source heading appears once. Home card summary adds price/options/ribbon scope rather than repeating only its title.

criteria.criterion: Useful local and vertical facts grounded in preserved evidence
criteria.reason: Current rendered copy retains byte-reviewed official facility address/room grouping and four original products, meaningful ribbon/final-cost/order limitations, without invented promises.

criteria.criterion: Actual internal targets and inbound buyer path
criteria.reason: Home body/card/navigation and support child link target the one article; brand/home recovery works in recorded flow. Support is noindex navigation, with breadcrumb absence explicitly within contract.

criteria.criterion: Provider-led guidance and real HTML CTA
criteria.reason: Actual HTML has eachSKU’s exact destination and tel18440644; expanded copy explains consultation next step and conditions. No image-only action.

criteria.criterion: Safe original/local media and useful alt
criteria.reason: Seven local image hashes equal approved assets, meaningful alt, correct contain rendering, four complete product images. Banners are generic marketing illustrations.

criteria.criterion: Production indexing/head/sitemap agreement
criteria.reason: Direct static/DOM checks: exact route-aware canonical/robots, OG9/Twitter5 on non404 routes, exact two-primary sitemap and noindex support/404.

criteria.criterion: Actual public production HTTP200/404 and endpoint checks
criteria.reason: PENDING_POST_PUBLICATION: loopback200/404 is not public HTTP. No points awarded. Full public-byte and resource verification, relevant external SKU responses and IndexNow remain separate.

criteria.criterion: Actual mobile/desktop readability and bounded usability
criteria.reason: 36 bound PNG files inspected across320/390/1280;15 DOM artifacts match release semantics. Menu click/Space/Enter and skip/local navigation evidence checked. Whole-page coverage resolves sticky overlap in element crops; exhaustive Tab traversal is outside coverage.

SEO.meaning: Disclosed internal evidence-based readiness rubric; not measured ranking, visibility, conversion or AI-citation performance

stage: Bounded prepublication artifact; S09 required and pending, not waived
unconfirmed: Public site HTTP, provider/host binding, external SKU response in this run, phone/checkout, live stock, per-order delivered total/timing, IndexNow/indexing/ranking
